name: System Changes
author: dDan4a
description: A history of changes to your setup: config files, packages and services. Describe each change in one line, see the diff, undo it with a click. Shows what your AI agents changed too.

barWidget.description: New config, package and service changes, with history and undo

schema.label: syschange binary
schema.description: Name or full path of the syschange CLI, for example ~/go/bin/syschange.

schema.label: Markdown export file
schema.description: Where the export button writes the history. To keep a file updated after every change: syschange export --auto FILE.
